Name: Flower Dance Partner Identifier
Author: pneuma163
Description:
[size=3]During the Flower Dance, see which NPCs you can ask to dance (or will say yes if you set that config) by hovering over them and seeing the small pink and yellow flower that appears next to the dialogue icon. If the NPC has nothing else to say other than the question prompt (i.e. you have seen all their festival dialogue) then the little flower will bounce up and down in time with the beat of the festival music (or at least it should be close).[/size]

[size=5]How to install:[/size]

[size=3]- Install the latest version of SMAPI [url=https://smapi.io]https://smapi.io[/url]
- Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
- Run the game using SMAPI.

If you need additional help installing the mod, the Stardew Valley wiki [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started[/url] has more detailed instructions.
To uninstall the mod, delete this mod's folder from your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.

Note: the mod can be installed (or removed) at any time.[/size]

[size=5]Configuration[/size]

[size=3]I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to set your configuration options, or you can edit the config.json that generates after you run the game with the mod installed.[/size]

[size=3]IndicatorCondition: whether the flower indicator appearing means you can ask the NPC to dance (CanAsk) which is the default or whether they actually will dance with you today when you ask (WillDance) based on your friendship points.[/size]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

[size=3]The mod's functionality should work with any vanilla or modded NPC. The mod is somewhat tested in multiplayer and should work correctly for any player (but let me know if it does not). The mod is designed to work in Stardew 1.6.15+ for desktop to reflect the experience of a player (and is designed to be forward compatible if the FlowerDanceCanDance fix means something to you). Android is untested.[/size]

[size=3]If another mod changes the conditions that the game checks for whether NPCs can dance with the player in an unexpected way, this mod may not accurately reflect that change.[/size]

[size=5]Translations[/size]

[size=3]If you would like to translate the mod, see my profile for general instructions regarding translations.[/size]
